# Mobile-SSH-Client---Split-Keyboard

> An SSH terminal for iPhone and iPad, used in landscape with a split keyboard on both sides of the shell, for driving tmux and Claude Code on your own Mac. iOS / iPadOS 17 or later, free (¥0). Not on the App Store or TestFlight: you build it from source with Xcode on a Mac and install it with a free Apple ID (a launchd job on the Mac re-installs it automatically before the 7-day signature expires).

For agents: the steps to install and set it up on this Mac and an iPhone or iPad are in get-started.md. Each step has the command to run and how to verify success; steps marked HUMAN-ONLY must be done by the human. Never guess a key fingerprint; use the one the human reads from the app. The Japanese pages are the primary source; config keys and the MCP server (splitterm) are documented only in Japanese.

## Runbook

- [Get Started](https://mobile-ssh-client---split-keyboard.pages.dev/en/get-started.md): the runbook an agent can execute (commands, verification, HUMAN-ONLY steps)
- [Overview](https://mobile-ssh-client---split-keyboard.pages.dev/en/index.md): what it is, who it is for, requirements, cost, distribution, security and privacy

## Japanese pages

- [config (Japanese)](https://mobile-ssh-client---split-keyboard.pages.dev/config.md): where the config file lives, its syntax, every key and default (generated from config.example)
- [MCP (Japanese)](https://mobile-ssh-client---split-keyboard.pages.dev/mcp.md): building the splitterm command, registering its MCP server, and the list of tools
- [Media (Japanese)](https://mobile-ssh-client---split-keyboard.pages.dev/media.md): sending photos, video and audio; video contact sheets; token estimates
- [FAQ (Japanese)](https://mobile-ssh-client---split-keyboard.pages.dev/faq.md): minimum iOS, price, App Store, 7-day signing, privacy, supported agents, limitations
